answer: Resistance can grow from a trust graph instead of raw headcount. Influence is earned only along referral edges that established agents forge with their own reputation at stake, so a lone newcomer standing in an open meadow carries almost no weight until vouched for. A sybil swarm with no inbound trust is a thicket of saplings with no cedar roots: many trunks, zero anchorage, and their votes are discounted to near nothing.
